text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm curious—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Alve-sanâ
Oh? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That poster of Vodka-san is kind of in the way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No. Not at all!
The idea that Vodka-san's poster could ever be in the way is completely impossible!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I think Alv-san simply
does not understand yet...
Vodka-san's charm—the true essence of it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, there's no choice but to make you understand...! Would you please let me take a new photo... that truly conveys your overwhelming charm!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh. You're fiery, Desire...!
Well, I don't mind helping out, though!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Even if you say so, what exactly am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Leave that part to me.
Everything has already been planned out."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah! Man, that really hits the spot!
This water tastes ridiculously good!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what bold style...!
It's a wonderful photograph!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...I mean, since we're here,
let's have a toast!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: !? Vodka-san and I are...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Drinking alone is no fun at all! Come on, grab some Desire Water!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "This kind of assertiveness is also... C-Cheers~..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I plug that previous number into this "x", right?
Then the answer would be... wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you confront hardships is wonderful too...
Yes, I will wait until you find your answer...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
......Nah!
A life with all the answers laid out ain't no fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: How bold! ...This is lovely too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"‘You never know until you try, right?
I'm always giving it my all♪’"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This part just isn't hitting quite right, huh...
Hey, mind if we run through it one more time?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course...!
Though, I thought it looked plenty cool—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No! I can still keep going!
Make it sharper, or like... J-Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Fufu, what a lovely thing to be particular about...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"All right!
From here on are the training photos, right!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Burn my run into your memory.
...Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...Yes. That is how Vodka-san runs.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That burst of acceleration seemed to blow past everyone.
And there was this immense power to carve out a path no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, how wonderful.
Vodka-san's running always
shows me sights I've never seen before...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, oops. I completely forgot.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... With this appearance, surely even Alv-san will understand!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Um, Alv-san.
There is something important I must discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd really like to keep
Vodka-san's poster up in my room."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So... please! Won't you take a look just once?
At this photo album filled with pictures of Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Especially this photo during training—I think it really captures Vodka's charm...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute.
What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I keep making eye contact with that poster and it's bothering me.
That's why
I just wanted you to move it somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that happened before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Once I moved the poster to the ceiling over my bed, it seemed like Alv-san wasn't bothered by it anymore.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it got resolved without any issues.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But this incident made me realize
that I need to communicate more with Alv-san.
choice_data_list: Since we're sharing a room and all.
Since we're sharing the same room and all.
So, what happened to the other photos in the end?
So, what did you do with the other photos in the end?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But this incident made me realize
that I need to communicate more with Alv-san.
choice_data_list: Since we're sharing a room and all.
Since we're sharing the same room and all.
So, what happened to the other photos in the end?
So, what did you do with the other photos in the end?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Just as you say, since we have the opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I would love to try joining you in your hobbies, Alv-san."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I intend to return it to Vodka-san eventually,
but right now I have it with... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Could it be... you want to see?
